claims.head: The Flames can’t afford to cough it up
claims.call: The Ducks get at least their usual 7.7% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
claims.body: The Ducks turn stolen pucks into chances, and the Flames are one of the league’s worst at avoiding breakdowns. A sloppy pass or two could cost the Flames.
claims.nums: Anaheim 6th for chances off turnovers (7.7% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Calgary 30th for avoiding breakdowns
claims.gist: The Ducks pounce on loose pucks, and the Flames cough them up.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Shots should fly both ways
claims.call: The game runs at more than 85.9 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, faster than either team’s usual.
claims.body: Anaheim plays some of the league’s fastest games, and so does Calgary. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.
claims.nums: Pace (shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams): Anaheim 4th (84.9), Calgary 2nd (85.9)
claims.gist: Both teams like a fast game.

CGY.head: A tough matchup for Calgary
CGY.body: Anaheim has controlled the play far better over recent games, Anaheim is playing for the second night in a row, and Calgary has home ice. Calgary can pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks.

ANA.head: The matchup suits Anaheim
ANA.body: Anaheim has controlled the play far better over recent games, Anaheim is playing for the second night in a row, and Calgary has home ice. Calgary can make it interesting if they pounce on loose pucks.

story.head: The Flames need a win
paras: The Flames haven’t won in four. The Ducks are 3-1-0.
